text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC) with associated neuropathy.

The patient describes an itchy rash on the upper body and face, along with numbness in the palms, which fits the classic presentation of PBC, often triggered by contact with wood dust or livestock in a farming environment. Has this rash been present for the full year, and have you noticed any fatigue or joint pain?
